title: Menu slot roll into a drifting image wall
summary: A one-line claim types in on pale grey, a sidebar menu rolls entry by entry like a slot drum, spins and lands on one entry, the camera pushes into it, a three-column image wall drifts up, and one card grows into a dimmed closing frame.
use_when: A tool or library with a long feature list where one category is the differentiator
A 15 to 20 s vertical reel narrated by VO, one claim per beat
The product owns a strong image set that can carry the second half
Moving from a calm light UI opening to a moody full-bleed close

look.type_style: medium grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; statement ~4 % H centred, menu entries ~2.5 % H with a line icon; close line ~4 % H, white, key words in bold

sfx.event: menu entry clicks into the centre slot
push into the landed entry and cut to the wall

structure.shot: small brand mark top centre on pale grey; a 7-word claim on two lines, names the sameness problem
structure.motion: word-reveal from 0.27 s, ~3 fr per word (±0.25 s), each word light grey -> ink over ~8 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outExpo; complete at 1.00 s, holds 30 fr

structure.shot: vertical menu drum: centre entry in ink with a line icon, one faded neighbour above and below; generic categories
structure.camera: locked frame, no scale or pan; only the drum content moves
structure.motion: drum steps one entry roughly every 30 fr, each step <= 8 fr (±0.25 s) springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); neighbours fade to ~20 % opacity at ±10 % H; each landing meets the VO naming it

structure.shot: the same drum spins fast: a new pair of entries in every cell, slot-machine style
structure.camera: locked frame, no scale or pan; only the drum content moves
structure.motion: spin ~4 entries per 0.25 s, decelerating, easings.outExpo 30 fr; lands on the hero entry at 7.27, settled by 7.50

structure.shot: drum at rest on the hero entry (the image category), neighbours faded
structure.camera: hold 38 fr, then push-in 1.00->~1.40 over ~11 fr (±0.25 s), easings.inExpo, cut while still accelerating
structure.motion: none besides the push; neighbours keep their ~20 % opacity

structure.shot: three-column wall of rounded image cards, columns offset, pale gutters; white capsule with mark and name at the top
structure.camera: dolly up ~2.4 px/fr at 720 w (~6.3 px/fr at 1920), easings.linear; scale drift 1.00->0.93 over 101 fr
structure.motion: capsule fades and un-blurs 9.00->9.50 (~12 fr, ±0.25 s), easings.outExpo; all columns travel together (parallax not measurable)

structure.shot: one portrait card in the middle column grows over its neighbours until it fills the frame
structure.camera: locked frame; the card scales, the camera does not
structure.motion: capsule fades out 12.00->12.27; card scale 1 -> ~3.3 and corner radius -> 0 over ~15 fr (±0.25 s), springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); image then dims to ~45 % by 12.77

structure.shot: full-bleed dimmed portrait; white petal mark upper third with the wordmark below
structure.motion: petals pop in one by one from 13.00, stagger ~4 fr (±0.25 s), springs.ui (overshoot not measurable), mark whole at 13.77; wordmark grey -> white fade 13.50->13.77 (~8 fr); hold 51 fr; both fade 15.50->15.77 (~8 fr)

structure.shot: same dimmed portrait; a 9-word closing promise on two lines, second line half in bold
structure.motion: word-reveal synced to VO: 3 words at 15.77, line 1 done by 16.00, line 2 from 16.77, complete at 17.00; each word ~8 fr fade (±0.25 s) easings.outExpo; holds 43 fr to the end

params.brand: brand.json: bg (pale grey), fg ink, muted, mark SVG, display font
params.content.hook: one claim, <= 8 words, two lines, names the problem
params.content.menu: 10-16 entries {icon, label}; the generic ones first, the hero entry last
params.content.heroEntry: the entry the spin lands on (index into menu)
params.content.images: 12-18 portrait/landscape images for the three-column wall; one marked as the closing image
params.content.name: product name or domain shown in the capsule and under the mark
params.content.close: closing promise, <= 10 words, two lines, words to bold
params.timing.vo: word timings to land each drum step and each word of the close
params.aspect: 9:16 native; 4:5 keeps three columns, 16:9 needs five

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Only one detected cut (8.90, 4.7 fr from the nearest beat): cut_on_beat 0/1. The opening text-to-menu change at 2.27 and the card growth at 12.27 are continuous moves the detector does not count. Drum steps follow the VO naming each category, not the music. The push into the landed entry accelerates into the hard cut (inExpo), unlike a slow push-in. Proposed terms (not used as ids): menu-drum, card-expand-fill, petal-assemble. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
